scope: Isolated provider follow-up; practice-level publisher branch/worktree untouched

capabilities.history: Current clinician selector; paired3/12windows use same practice cutoff and common covered-month set; attendance/week, established-active average, established cadence, first practice starts, prior-clinician starts and attributed leads
capabilities.reconciliation: Practice unique clients once; shared latest-date clients count once per participating clinician. Global third-date qualification preserved; transfer is not new practice acquisition. Actual session totals reconcile across providers; overlapping client-day pairs are explicitly not summed as unique people.
capabilities.actualProviderResponse: Only fully attributed, structurally valid original lead periods enter provider calibration. Partial/unassigned months withheld rather than misrepresented as complete provider denominators.
capabilities.proxy: Explicit opt-in per provider; practice future-arrival response plus provider current stock/cadence/capacity. Zero waiting pipeline is a visible scenario assumption, not a recorded queue. Incomplete lead totals stay provisional; source uncertainty cannot be bypassed.
capabilities.constraints: Per-provider conditional capacity paths and lead ceilings; explicit allocations plus modeled provider intakes checked against practice series; missing service/specialty suitability remains unknown. No automatic patient routing.
capabilities.staffing: Optional reconciliation of unique enabled clinician.hire events with known template identity, first-of-month starts, no dependencies/end-date ambiguity. Delay and ramp preserved; stable event IDs prevent duplicate copying. Matching unlinked overlays require review. Hiring profiles alone are templates, not automatic hire decisions.
capabilities.persistence: Provider assumptions and allocations use optional growthPlanning.providerPlans through existing staged-save and selected-plan save/reopen workflow. Scenario edits never change actual clinician/session/lead records.

verification.independent: Provider logic, attribution, shared-client reconciliation, source uncertainty, staffing mapping and saved-plan isolation accepted after corrections
verification.browser: Synthetic real-component desktop1440/mobile390/320; keyboard proxy toggle, clinician switching, over-allocation/overload warnings, one-time staffing copy, reload persistence, missing coverage, source preservation

remainingLimits: No live authenticated private-import reconciliation or Mac verification by author; parent publisher coordinates those.
Service/specialty suitability is not recorded sufficiently and remains unknown; capacity estimates do not certify safe routing.
Ambiguous/dependent/partial-month/end-dated hire events are reported for review, not guessed. Arbitrary legacy capacity/room events are not converted into new-hire overlays.
Provider proxy is assumption-bound and not measured provider conversion; practice/provider projections need not sum because current-client frequencies and exposure populations differ.
Saved-plan UI acceptance uses synthetic browser storage plus actual schema/save-reopen helper tests, not production writes.
release: Compose only this delta onto the published practice-level source; preserve publisher artifact pins and consultation fix. No author deployment.
